---
name: complete-the-work
description: Steps for completing new features, bug fixes, refactoring, or other code changes.
---

Follow these steps:

 - Review the code changes so you understand the work that was done.
 - Confirm that you are on `main` branch.
 - Checkout a new branch.
 - Add all the current changes (add everything).
 - Commit with a descriptive message.
 - Push the branch to GitHub.
 - Open a pull request to merge the branch into `main`.
 - Update the pull request description with details about the changes and why they were made.
 - Merge the pull request immediately.
 - Checkout main and pull the latest changes.
